source_contract.maps: Exact caller-defined source columns to output fields; no inferred business rules or source aliases
source_contract.input_precedence: explicit role path, otherwise declared default; invalid explicit path never falls back
source_contract.handoff: Other modules may read normalizer-result.json by explicit path only if their own declared input schema accepts it; not an automatic Worktime/PTO/Payroll schema adapter

limitations: Generic row mapping, not a company-policy normalizer or payroll calculation
Raw values and identifiers in the result require private storage and caller authorization
The result does not automatically satisfy PTO/Worktime/Payroll input schemas
No implicit Workflow invocation, predecessor or successor module imports
Gearbox integration and actual cross-module E2E remain for stages 3 and 4
